details.description: DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite-Base is the pretrained (non-instruction-tuned) checkpoint in DeepSeek's DeepSeek-Coder-V2 family of code-focused models, from DeepSeek AI. It is a 16-billion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 2.4 billion active parameters per forward pass, built by further pretraining an intermediate DeepSeek-V2 checkpoint on 6 trillion additional tokens of code- and math-heavy data, per DeepSeek's GitHub repository. It supports 338 programming languages, up from 86 in the original DeepSeek-Coder, and a 128,000-token context window per DeepSeek's documentation. As a base checkpoint it has not been instruction-tuned, so it is intended for continued pretraining, fine-tuning or raw completion rather than following chat instructions directly.
advantages: Supports 338 programming languages, expanded from 86 in the original DeepSeek-Coder, per DeepSeek's GitHub repository.
Uses a sparse Mixture-of-Experts architecture with only 2.4 billion active parameters out of 16 billion total, per DeepSeek's Hugging Face model card.
Trained with 6 trillion additional tokens of continued pretraining from an intermediate DeepSeek-V2 checkpoint, per DeepSeek's GitHub repository.
disadvantages: This is the base (pretrained) checkpoint, not instruction-tuned, so it is not designed to follow chat instructions directly.

DeepSeek's GitHub repository publishes math and general-reasoning benchmark numbers (HumanEval, MBPP+, GSM8K, MATH, LiveCodeBench) only for the instruction-tuned Lite-Instruct variant, not this base checkpoint.
use_cases: Continued pretraining or fine-tuning for downstream code models.
Base checkpoint for building instruction-tuned or task-specific coding models.

notes: Catalog's max_input_tokens and max_output_tokens (163,840, identical for both) exceed DeepSeek's documented native context of 128,000 tokens; kept per catalog facts as instructed. Correction: DeepSeek's GitHub repository does publish base-checkpoint benchmark numbers -- a 'Code Completion' table (section 3.2) reports RepoBench (Python) 38.9, RepoBench (Java) 43.3 and HumanEval FIM 86.4 specifically for DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite-Base, now added to evaluations. Only the math/general-reasoning tables (HumanEval, MBPP+, GSM8K, MATH, LiveCodeBench, AIME) are Lite-Instruct-only.
